summary: Shoppers see a Prep Shop-style favicon in modern and older browsers.

acceptanceCriteria.original: Choose a relevant icon in line with the style of the site.
acceptanceCriteria.refined: Use the existing kawaii shopping-basket illustration as the browser favicon so it matches the Prep Shop visual style.

risk.rationale: This is a static, decorative image choice with no effect on shopping tasks.

testApproach.reason: The artwork is static and decorative; review its appearance during exploratory testing.

acceptanceCriteria.original: Add it so that it is shown in both modern and old browsers
acceptanceCriteria.refined: Declare a modern PNG favicon and a legacy ICO favicon on every site page, with both local assets available so supported browsers can display the site icon.

risk.rationale: A missing or unsupported favicon is cosmetic, though adding metadata across all pages creates some consistency risk.

testApproach.reason: Check every page's icon declarations and both local formats during exploratory testing.

decisions.decision: Reuse the existing kawaii shopping-basket illustration as the favicon artwork.
decisions.evidence: img/basket-icon.png is the site's existing square, kawaii basket illustration and matches the shop's logo and visual style.

decisions.decision: Provide a PNG favicon for modern browsers and a conventional ICO favicon for legacy browsers.
decisions.evidence: The ticket explicitly requires modern and old browser support; PNG and ICO declarations are the established static favicon formats for those browser generations.

decisions.decision: Declare the favicons on all six existing HTML pages.
decisions.evidence: Each static page is part of the same Prep Shop site and should display the same browser identity; the site has six root-level HTML pages.
